topBar.noTasksText: Scans, downloads, backups and Claude’s work will show up here.

home.title: Nothing to show yet
home.text: Once the catalog is loaded you will see the next game of each route, what needs review and what is new.

discover.title: Nothing to recommend yet
discover.text: Claude will recommend sagas based on what you like and tell you why.

review.title: Nothing to review
review.text: What the app decided with doubts will show up here: identifications, routes to approve and Claude’s learnings.

downloads.title: No downloads
downloads.text: Here you will see JDownloader, megapacks and every step of the import.

tools.title: No emulators or ports yet
tools.text: Emulators, ports, add-ons and system files will be installed and updated here.

steam.title: Nothing to export
steam.text: Here you will see which games go to Steam, with their saga category and art.

welcome.intro: Catalog your sagas, organize your games, emulators and ports on any drive, and bring it all to Steam. This takes a few minutes.
welcome.chooseText: This holds the database, the Tools (emulators, ports, BIOS) and the image cache. It takes a lot of space: pick a drive with room. To switch PCs, just move this folder.
welcome.nextSteps: Backup, Steam and the remaining steps turn on with their phase.
welcome.librariesText: Choose which drives keep games and tools: each gets an Otteretro folder with everything in order. If you already have a folder with the old layout, adopt it and it moves to the standard on its own.
welcome.librariesFound: We found folders with the old layout:
welcome.accountsText: If you pay for 1fichier or Mega, leave your key here to download with your account. It is optional: you can do it later in Settings › Accounts and keys.

settings.later: Backup and the remaining settings arrive with their phase.

consoles.title: Consoles
consoles.help: Turned-off consoles don't show in Sagas, Collection or search. Nothing is deleted: turn them back on and they return.

location.queued: it is in the tasks panel

detail.pick: Pick a console to see its games, emulators, ports and system files.
detail.noGames: No game location has a folder for this console.
detail.noEmulators: No emulator is installed for this console.
detail.noSystem: No BIOS or keys for this console in a system location.

dataFolder.useHelp: The app will start using that folder (for example, one you bring from another PC). The current one is not moved or deleted. If the chosen folder is empty, you will start from scratch.
dataFolder.dontClose: Do not close the app until it finishes.

channel.title: Updates
channel.stableHint: The versions published on GitHub: tested and with their release notes.
channel.testingHint: The latest in development, before it is published. It may have bugs.
channel.localHint: The packages you build on this computer with scripts/empaquetar.ps1. They are found on their own in the Otteretro\Paquetes folder of your disks.
channel.customHint: A folder, a web address or the GitHub repo of someone who builds their own Otteretro.
channel.localNone: None of your disks has packages in Otteretro\Paquetes.

reason.notInstalled: Updates only work in the installed app.

collection.unlinked: In your stores, not in the catalog yet
collection.unlinkedHint: They show up anyway; once their series is loaded from IGDB they move to the grid.
collection.emptyText: They are not in the catalog yet. They will come with a future version.
collection.name: Game
collection.scanHelp: Looks for your games in Juegos on each drive and marks what you own.
collection.scanQueued: Scanning: follow it in the tasks panel.
collection.verifyHelp: Hashes your files for this console and checks them against No-Intro or Redump, offline.
collection.verifyQueued: Verifying: follow it in the tasks panel.
collection.importHelp: Brings the games in a folder to your disks, each in its place.
collection.importHint: First you see what is there. Each game moves to Juegos on its disk: it is copied, verified and only then deleted from here. Anything whose console is unknown stays in the folder.
collection.importQueued: Import queued: follow it in the tasks panel.
collection.convertHelp: Turns what you have of this console into RVZ or CHD. The original is deleted after checking the copy.
collection.convertQueued: Conversion queued: follow it in the tasks panel.
collection.importEmpty: No games found in that folder.
collection.importOnlyCatalog: Only what is in the catalog

collection.noneText: Import a folder, drop your games in Entrada or try another filter.

game.noCompare: Claude hasn't compared this game's versions yet.
game.verifyQueued: Verifying: follow it in the tasks panel.
game.removeHint: What you mark goes to the recycle bin and stops counting as owned. Updates and DLC only go if you mark them.

notices.title: Notices

notices.unidentified: {count, plural, one {1 unidentified file} other {# unidentified files}}: pick its game in Review.

review.pendingEmptyText: When Claude prepares a saga's routes, what's iconic or the best version, they'll show up here for you to approve.
review.learningsEmptyText: The changes Claude made to the catalog stay here, with their reason, so you can undo them.
review.correctPlaceholder: What is wrong (Claude reads it in the next cleanup)

files.doubtfulEmptyText: When Claude assigns a file the scan did not recognize, it shows up here for you to confirm.
files.unidentifiedEmptyText: Files that neither the scan nor Claude recognize show up here for you to pick their game.

home.nextEmpty: Follow a route in a saga and your next game will show up here.

libraries.migrationStarted: The migration is in the tasks panel. You can keep using the app meanwhile.
libraries.queued: It is in the tasks panel.
libraries.removeHelp: «{name}» is removed from Otteretro. No file is deleted: you can add it back whenever you want.
libraries.addDiskHelp: Pick a drive: Otteretro creates an Otteretro folder on it with Juegos, Emuladores, Ports, Complementos and Sistema. One per drive.
libraries.noOtherDisk: Add another drive to move things between them.
libraries.moveTo: Move {count, plural, =0 {the selection} one {1 item} other {# items}} ({size}) to

migration.title: Move to the standard layout
migration.help: These folders use the old layout. Moving them puts each thing in its drive's fixed folder (on the same drive it's a rename) and Herramientas on the default drive, with emulator paths updated.

recognize.title: Recognize games
recognize.text: What no script recognizes (name, ID, tables, hash) can go to Claude, with your subscription, when a scan or import finishes.
recognize.useClaude: Use Claude when no script recognizes it
recognize.off: Off: what isn't recognized goes straight to Review › Unidentified.
recognize.month: This month: {calls, plural, one {# call} other {# calls}} · {cost}
recognize.paused: Your subscription hit its limit: it resumes on its own on {at}.

tools.emptyText: When you adopt a game location with the old layout, its emulators and ports land here. From F5 on they are installed and updated from this screen.
tools.noRecipeHelp: Otteretro does not know yet how to make it portable or rewrite its paths.
tools.pick: Pick a tool to see its details.
tools.systemHelp: Your BIOS, keys and firmware, with versions, in Sistema on the ★ disk. You upload them: Otteretro neither downloads nor shares them. A new version never replaces the previous one.
tools.systemEmptyText: Choose a console and upload your BIOS, keys or firmware.
